lines.en: Yeah, I'm definitely... I don't like the name Ross.
What a weird way to kick me when I'm down.
No, no, I just... I meant for the baby.
Well, it's just, you know, something like this would never happen to, like, the Hulk, you know.
In The Incredible Hulk, uh, number 72, Dr. Bruce Banner found...
You know, never mind. My girlfriend's a lesbian.
So, I just thought I'm definitely gonna go with either Joey or Chandler.
Oh, oh, oh, oh, what? You gotta pick Joey.
I mean, name one famous person named Chandler.
Okay, there are no famous Joeys, except for, huh, Joey Buttafuoco.
Yeah, that guy really hurt us.
Well, but how about a compromise, then, okay?
What if it's, you know, Chan-o-y?
Okay, look, Joey? Come on, think about it.
First of all, he'll never be president.
I mean, there's never gonna be a President Joey.
All right, look, man, I don't want to bring this up,
but Chandler is the stupidest name I've ever heard in my life.
It's barely even a word, okay?
It's kind of like Chandelier, but it's not.
I have a horrible, horrible name.
So I guess it's Joey, then.
I am sorry about what I said.
From now on, I have no first name.
All right, so what are we supposed to call you?
Okay, uh, for now, temporarily, you can call me...
No way are you cool enough to pull off Clint.
Okay, so what name am I cool enough to pull off?
Am I a Mark or a John?
Yeah, you're not tall enough to be a Mark.
But you might make a good Barney.
All right, look, I am serious, okay?
Tomorrow at 3.30, I'm going down to the courthouse.
You're actually going through with this?
Hey, look, this name has been holding me back my entire life, okay?
It's probably why kids picked on me in school and why I never do well with women.
So, as of 4 o'clock tomorrow, I'm either going to be Mark Johnson or John Markson.
You've got problems because of you, not your name.
All right, this has got to stop.
I know you really wanted me to name the baby Joey, but so I'm going to name the baby Chandler.
Yeah, but you have to keep the name, too.
You want to hug it out?
Okay, I'm going to go tell Frank and Alice right now.
